# Security policy

## Supported version

Only the current `main` branch is supported while Algoria is under active development.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Do not open a public issue for a suspected vulnerability. Report it privately through GitHub Security Advisories, at <https://github.com/berkingurcan/algoria/security/advisories/new>.

Include reproduction steps, affected routes or components, impact, and any suggested mitigation. Do not include real credentials, wallet secrets, payment credentials, or personal data.

Expect an acknowledgement within 72 hours. If none arrives, please keep the details private and try again rather than disclosing publicly; a maintainer being slow is not a reason for a finding to become public before it is fixed.

If you believe a credential was exposed, revoke or rotate it before sending the report.
